lines.1: The next day, on the way to school.
lines.7: 「I'm still worried about that feeling of being watched. Even now, it feels like someone's looking at me.」
lines.9: 「Hey, don't worry! If anything happens, I'll protect you!」
lines.13: 「S-Samesuga, this woman matches the description of the suspicious person Iron-senpai told us about.」
lines.15: 「Blonde ponytail, curvy, bare midriff... You're right.」
lines.16: 「Sato, come with me for a minute.」
lines.18: 「Wait! What are you planning to do with Yoppi?」
lines.20: 「(Hehehe. I'm having a conversation with a beautiful woman.)」
lines.21: 「Something about you is just instinctively gross, nya.」
lines.22: 「If you won't come, I'll have to make you accompany me.」
lines.28: 「Come on. I won't do anything rough. Come along.」
lines.33: 「...Wait, this is Matsukasa Park. Why am I here?」
lines.36: 「Did I wander into paradise without realizing it!?」
lines.37: 「Oh, you're awake. Perfect timing. I've got a little errand for you.」
lines.40: 「S-sorry. Looks like she brought you here by force.」
lines.42: 「Auu. I know we look suspicious, but... we won't hurt you. Here, have some tea.」
lines.44: 「You just need to stay here quietly, okay?」
lines.45: 「Yoppi is pressed up against some tall, scary-looking woman!?」
lines.46: 「We've taken custody of your precious workforce. If you want her back, the entire executive committee is invited to Matsukasa Park.」
